newsitem.title: UK: ICI slips amid worries about Q3 figures.
newsitem.headline: ICI slips amid worries about Q3 figures.

text.p: Shares in British chemicals group ICI lost more than one percent on Wednesday amid worries about the company's third-quarter results due for release on Thursday.
ICI shares were down nine pence at 772-1/2p in late morning trade. Just over 702,000 shares had changed hands.
The stock has fallen steadily from a high of 933p this year, hit by a string of earnings downgrades.

ICI is expected to report pre-tax profits of between 127.0 million stg and 140.0 million stg for the third quarter compared with 216 million stg a year earlier because of a continued deterioration in polyester prices.
Marketmakers said they expected ICI shares to hold steady at current levels before the results.
